note: Provider-reported media generation cost settlements (generation-cost-settlement.ts), one JSON per job, read by the Chronos cost summary and used to dedupe resource-usage rows. A registered tier/tenant-partitioned runtime-state root (PARTITIONED_RUNTIME_STATE_ROOTS.generation_cost_settlements): tenant settlements live under <tier>/<tenant>/ (tier-guarded, backed up, exported and removed by tenant offboarding), untenanted ones under system/. Pre-migration copies under tenants/<slug>/ (or the bare root) stay readable until the next write for the job moves them; tenant offboarding also removes leftover tenants/<slug>/ copies (PHYSICAL_LEGACY_TENANT_STATE_ROOTS).
